definition.simple: A theory stating that all matter is made of tiny, indestructible building blocks called atoms.
definition.academic: A scientific theory proposed by John Dalton stating that all matter consists of indivisible particles called atoms, atoms of the same element are identical, and compounds are combinations of different types of atoms.

examples: According to Dalton, if you cut a piece of gold in half infinitely, you will eventually reach a single gold atom that cannot be cut further.

common_misconceptions: Dalton was completely right. (False: We later found out atoms CAN be divided into protons, neutrons, and electrons!).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Dalton provided the very first scientific explanation for the laws of chemical combination!
